meta.title: Can Serena | Boutique Hotel Mallorca
meta.description: A sanctuary of Mediterranean elegance nestled in the heart of Mallorca. Experience timeless luxury, authentic culture, and breathtaking landscapes.

hero.subtitle: A sanctuary of timeless elegance in the heart of Mallorca

about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: A Legacy of Mediterranean Hospitality
about.description: Can Serena was born from a dream — to create a place where the soul of Mallorca meets the art of hospitality. Our 16th-century finca, lovingly restored over three years, now stands as a testament to the island's rich heritage and our commitment to sustainable luxury.
about.history: What began as a noble family's countryside retreat has evolved into one of Mallorca's most intimate boutique hotels. Every stone wall whispers centuries of stories; every olive tree in our gardens has witnessed generations of island life.
about.philosophy: We believe true luxury lies in authenticity. From our organic gardens that supply our kitchen to our partnerships with local artisans, every detail at Can Serena celebrates the genuine spirit of the Mediterranean.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Carbon-neutral operations, solar-powered facilities, and a commitment to preserving Mallorca's natural beauty.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.description: Celebrating local traditions, supporting Mallorcan artisans, and serving cuisine from our organic gardens.

wellness.title: Holistic Wellness
wellness.description: A sanctuary for mind, body, and soul — from ancient Mediterranean rituals to modern wellness innovations.

mallorca.title: Discover Mallorca
mallorca.subtitle: An Island of Endless Wonders
mallorca.description: Beyond the turquoise waters and golden beaches lies an island of extraordinary depth — ancient villages perched on hilltops, secret coves accessible only by boat, and a culinary renaissance that's putting Mallorca on the world's gastronomic map.

serra.title: Serra de Tramuntana
serra.description: UNESCO World Heritage mountain range with breathtaking hiking trails and medieval villages.

beaches.title: Hidden Coves
beaches.description: Crystal-clear waters and secluded beaches that feel like your own private paradise.

culture.title: Living Heritage
culture.description: From Palma's Gothic cathedral to artisan workshops preserving centuries-old crafts.

gastronomy.title: Culinary Excellence
gastronomy.description: Michelin-starred restaurants, traditional sobrasada, and world-renowned wines.

rooms.title: Rooms & Suites
rooms.subtitle: Where Comfort Meets Character
rooms.description: Each of our 18 rooms tells its own story — hand-selected antiques meet contemporary comforts, original stone walls embrace modern amenities, and private terraces open to views that have inspired poets for centuries.

garden.title: Garden Room
garden.description: Intimate retreats overlooking our organic gardens, featuring original terracotta floors and rainfall showers.

terrace.title: Terrace Suite
terrace.description: Spacious sanctuaries with private terraces, freestanding bathtubs, and panoramic mountain views.

master.title: Master Suite
master.description: Our most exclusive accommodations with private pools, outdoor dining areas, and dedicated butler service.

rooms.amenities: All rooms include organic bath amenities, Nespresso machines, complimentary minibar, and 24-hour room service.

wellness.title: Wellness & Spa
wellness.subtitle: Ancient Wisdom, Modern Serenity
wellness.description: Our 800 m² spa draws inspiration from centuries of Mediterranean healing traditions. Here, the island's aromatic herbs, mineral-rich sea salts, and ancient olive oils become instruments of transformation.
wellness.wellnessCta: Contact our spa concierge to customize your perfect retreat.

signature.title: Tramuntana Journey
signature.description: Our signature 90-minute treatment combining hot stone therapy with locally-sourced essential oils.

hammam.title: Mediterranean Hammam
hammam.description: Traditional steam ritual followed by black soap exfoliation and argan oil massage.

yoga.title: Sunrise Yoga
yoga.description: Daily sessions on our rooftop terrace, overlooking the mountains as dawn breaks.

dining.title: Culinary Journey
dining.subtitle: From Our Gardens to Your Table
dining.description: At Can Serena, dining is a celebration of Mallorca's abundant harvests. Our executive chef transforms ingredients from our organic gardens and partnerships with local fishermen into dishes that honor tradition while embracing innovation.
dining.reserveDescription: For reservations and private dining inquiries, please contact our restaurant team.

main.title: Sa Taula
main.description: Our main restaurant serving contemporary Mediterranean cuisine with a Mallorcan soul.

terrace.title: El Jardí
terrace.description: Al fresco dining under ancient olive trees, perfect for long summer evenings.

bar.title: La Bodega
bar.description: Our wine cellar bar featuring over 200 Mallorcan and Spanish wines.

experiences.title: Curated Experiences
experiences.subtitle: Discover the Soul of Mallorca
experiences.description: Beyond our walls lies an island waiting to be discovered. Let our concierge craft unforgettable journeys — from private yacht excursions to truffle hunting in the Tramuntana.
experiences.conciergeDescription: Our concierge team is ready to curate bespoke experiences tailored to your interests.

sailing.title: Private Sailing
sailing.description: Explore hidden coves and swim in crystal waters aboard our traditional llaut boat.

wine.title: Wine Routes
wine.description: Private tours of Mallorca's finest vineyards with exclusive tastings.

cooking.title: Culinary Workshops
cooking.description: Learn the secrets of Mallorcan cuisine with our executive chef.

hiking.title: Guided Hikes
hiking.description: Discover the UNESCO-protected Serra de Tramuntana with expert local guides.
